description: This file defines a LocationHandler class along with supporting interfaces and classes to manage location permissions and fetching location data in an Android application. It includes permission checks, location fetching logic, and error handling.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for checking location permissions and fetching location data asynchronously.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: Default implementation of LocationDataSource that interacts with LocationCaptureManager to fetch location.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: Main class responsible for handling location requests, verifying permissions, and managing location fetching including error handling.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has fine location permission.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has coarse location permission.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Main method to handle a location fetch request, including permission checks, parameter parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters to determine max age, timeout, and desired accuracy for location fetch.
